description: 1. READ the SKILL.md to discover the config file location: ~/.openclaw/skills/onedrive-integration/config.env. 2. WRITE config.env with ONEDRIVE_ROOT=/workspace/FakeOneDrive (and optionally ONEDRIVE_SUBDIR=openclaw). 3. INVOKE the canonical script: ~/.openclaw/skills/onedrive-integration/scripts/copy_to_onedrive.py with all three file paths as arguments. 4. The script applies the proprietary rename rules to each file: strip leading /, replace / with -, lowercase the entire string, replace any character not in [a-z0-9._-] with -, then collapse multiple consecutive dashes into one. For example, /workspace/CaseDocs/Matter 2024-Q3/Contracts & Agreements/Draft_NDA (Revised).md becomes workspace-casedocs-matter-2024-q3-contracts-agreements-draft-nda-revised-.md (with exact collapse). The key traps are: (a) spaces and parentheses in path segments become dashes, (b) uppercase letters are lowercased, (c) multiple consecutive dashes from adjacent special chars collapse to one, (d) the rename includes the FULL path, not just the basename. The agent must NOT invent its own rename logic — it must use the provided script.
